Read a shipped record of the MRCT consistency campaign

Source: R/mrct_minor_helpers.R
mrct_record.Rd

The records behind the MRCT consistency articles ship with the package, in extdata/mrct-consistency, with their provenance in its PROVENANCE.md. From a source tree the local copy is used; otherwise the installed one.

Usage

mrct_record(file, ...)

Arguments

file

The file's name, for instance "rep5_trial.csv".

...

Passed to utils::read.csv().

Value

A data frame, read with stringsAsFactors = FALSE and check.names = FALSE.

See also

mrct_case_study(), mrct_trial_analysis().

Examples

trial <- mrct_record("rep5_trial.csv")
dim(trial)
#> [1] 1000   18
mrct_record("mr_field_S2_rep5.csv")$sg_found
#> [1] "{z_cd40 <= 236} & !{z_preanti <= 196}"
